title: Rank-2 hyperbolic H = omega(w) U_D has period 4 in the coset
structure: the coset splits into 4 cyclic H-eigenspaces (eigenvalues i, -1, -i, 1) of equal dimension 2
significance: the rank-2 hyperbolic A = w U_D has the same cyclic-subspace structure as the cat map.  The coset is a direct sum of 1-dimensional H-invariant subspaces, each carrying the character of the multiplicative group of order 4.  This is the rank-2 analogue of Theorems I/II (the Hecke torus structure).
theorem: ||P H^p P||^2 = |coset| if p ≡ 0 mod 4, = 1 if p ≡ 2 mod 4, = |coset|^2/G otherwise
